experiment: report-only explicit-revision rerank across real MCP subprocesses
validation: Four probe tests, prior session-effect test and 37 MCP tests: 42 passed using a fresh dedicated pytest basetemp.
decision: Reject production promotion. A manually asserted revision edge has no verified scope/truth contract; one false edge promotes the wrong environment. No SDK/MCP default was changed.
cost_boundary: No model/API calls. One extra MCP link call is needed to assert a revision; its measured tool round trip excludes human or agent work to identify a true correction. Timings are one-run observations, not latency percentiles. Final answer quality remains unmeasured.
